title: DadBod Destroyer
author: Josh Green
desc: More discipline, more muscle, more lean.  This is the most complete workout plan you can squeeze into a 4x/week, 60 min workout routine that focuses on the biggest impact movements and cuts out wasteful time at the gym.  Progressive overload, supersets, dropsets and maximum calorie burn means each workout will take more out of you than ever before - but you want results and that will require more action, effort, and consistency on your part than ever before.
